reading.title: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
reading.summary: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress — and states across the country -— would crack down on AI and data centers.

news.title: Ex-lawmaker gets 12.5 years in Macao's first national security case
news.summary: Au's arrest last year was the first publicly known prosecution under Macao's national security law since it was enacted in 2009.
